prompts.nw:

Produce a genuinely high-resolution detailed repaint of TARGET reference 1 at 2048x1566 pixels or maximum available resolution in the SAME aspect ratio. This is a production terrain tile, not a new composition. Preserve EVERY silhouette, exact framing, object positions, door positions, proportions, road widths, stepping-stone positions, grass/road edges, partial buildings clipped by the canvas, and all four canvas boundaries EXACTLY. Return exactly one finished opaque tile filling canvas, no grid, frame or montage.
THIS TILE: NORTHWEST quadrant: large open woodland lawn and grove, partial school at RIGHT edge and partial house/shop at BOTTOM edge must stay clipped exactly. Preserve broad empty lawn and existing trees.
